However, these focus on preventing degradation during fine-tuning rather than providing a pytest-style regression testing harness that continuously monitors safety across model checkpoints. The CI/CD integration angle — a reusable test suite that runs automatically against each checkpoint — is a software engineering contribution not directly published, though the underlying safety benchmarks it would use already exist.
